rationale: Recent runs around the reverse recurrent-tail baseline are mostly flat, so this keeps that winning family intact and spends the edit on a new structural idea instead of another scalar sweep. The change adds a late-phase suffix-weighted training loss that better matches the official sliding-window scorer: it reuses the existing masked-loss path, ramps emphasis across the last few eval strides of each sequence, normalizes the mask so optimizer scale stays stable, and activates before the quant-aware export endgame without changing evaluation, data paths, or final int8+zlib roundtrip.
title: Late-Phase Validation-Aligned Tail Loss
